Every Person, Team, membership, role, responsibility, owner, and source reference resolves or produces a typed gap.

acceptance_conditions: The package owns exactly one Product Capability identity.
Leaf and composite work retain one versioned outer contract.
Nested composition never creates a second execution authority.
Every structural route names its event selector, target, and input mapping.
Every cycle carries an explicit limit and exhaustion route.
Commands and accepted events remain idempotent under stable keys.
The same ordered accepted history and reducer version rebuild the same structural cursor.
Structural routing cannot manufacture domain truth, approval, artifact admission, or result quality.
Parentage does not transmit tools, context, budget, evidence, communication permission, or authority.
Every external effect crosses an exact adapter and authority-reference boundary.
Integration selects one accepted-history and scheduling authority without a competing journal.
Unknown operators, contracts, versions, capabilities, or routes fail closed.
exclusions: selecting or implementing the RWO proposal or any other scheduler
granting recursive orchestration authority to nested composites
deciding business truth, approval, artifact meaning, or result quality
authorizing agent communication, tools, credentials, or external effects
owning retry, compensation, cancellation, timeout, or domain lifecycle policy
claiming exactly-once business effects or universal termination
representing unbounded streams or dynamic topology without a later accepted extension
creating a second authoritative scheduler, journal, or coordination store
